chapters.summary: Obadiah declares God's judgment on Edom for their pride and their evil deeds against their brother Jacob, and prophesies Israel's restoration and the coming of God's kingdom.
keyPoints: Edom's pride deceives them into thinking their lofty position makes them untouchable, but God will bring them down.
Edom stood aloof while their brother was in distress, even looting in the day of his calamity, and God will repay them according to their deeds.
The day of the LORD draws near, when all nations will be judged, but on mount Zion there will be deliverance, and Israel will possess their inheritance.
chapters.application: Let us be on guard against pride in our hearts and walk in humility, caring for our brothers and sisters in their times of trouble rather than rejoicing over their misfortune. God will surely vindicate what is right, and we can trust in his promises.
